provenance.title: NER states reference table
provenance.description: Administrative reference for the eight states of the North Eastern Region of India. Areas are Survey of India published values; populations are Census of India 2011 (state totals, published).
provenance.accuracy: Administrative fields are exact published values. Bounding boxes are approximate envelopes used only to place the grid.

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.terrain_summary: Eastern Himalaya; Siang, Subansiri, Kameng and Lohit basins. Elevation range ~90 m to >6,000 m.

states.name: Assam
states.terrain_summary: Brahmaputra valley floor (35-120 m) flanked by Himalayan foothills to the north and the Karbi Anglong / Barail ranges to the south; Barak valley in the south-east.

states.name: Manipur
states.terrain_summary: Central Imphal valley (~780 m) ringed by the Manipur Hills; Naga and Chin hill ranges on the east.

states.name: Meghalaya
states.terrain_summary: Shillong Plateau and Garo-Khasi-Jaintia hills, 200-1,965 m, incised by deep south-flowing gorges.

states.name: Mizoram
states.terrain_summary: North-south trending Mizo hills (500-2,000 m), steep flysch ridges with very high relative relief.

states.name: Nagaland
states.terrain_summary: Naga Hills on the Assam-Arakan fold belt; steep shaley ridges 200-3,841 m (Mount Saramati).

states.name: Sikkim
states.terrain_summary: Steepest elevation gradient in India: 280 m at the Teesta exit to 8,586 m at Kangchenjunga over ~80 km.

states.name: Tripura
states.terrain_summary: Low north-south anticlinal hill ranges (15-930 m) surrounded by alluvial plains of the Haora, Gomati and Manu rivers.
